paragraphs.text: You who are Levites and chiefly appointed to this office.
paragraphs.label: a

paragraphs.text: For their charge was not only to keep the temple, but to pray there and to give God thanks.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: And therefore has all power, bless you with his fatherly love declared in Zion. Thus the Levites used to praise the Lord, and bless the people.
paragraphs.label: c
paragraphs.anchor: made heaven and earth bless thee
